Sergio / Monica — this looks like a standard accelerator credit request. Quick note on structure:

- Approve $25k credit (one-time promo) tied to account LB-2027-0913.
- Trial extension: OK for 14 days with auto-expiry; mark as non-billable.
- Condition: SOW signature or HubSpot deal acceptance required within 14 days of credit activation.

Rishi / Sergio — finance sign-off with conditions. See attached credit_terms.docx (stub). Key points:

- $25,000 promotional credit applied to hosted usage only; no cash payout.
- Credit expires 90 days after activation unless SOW signed; if usage prior to signature exceeds $5,000 in billable tokens, we reserve the right to reclaim up to $5,000 from future invoices (simple clawback).
- Trial extension approved (14 days) for sandbox accounts; no invoices generated during extension window.
- Require SOW or PO within 14 days of credit activation. If no SOW/PO, credits void and any billable usage will be invoiced retroactively.
